old_problem: The source contains a one-hour FurMark requirement in Items and 20-minute Machine Time, while Procedure has no duration. Earlier reviews lacked the later approved rule that a short smoke or scheduling estimate cannot replace a formal long-duration test, so they left duration undecidable. FurMark mode, score/stability, ECC, thermal and visual thresholds also remained unbound.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending, Source Conflict and BLOCKED. ED-14 directly selects the formal one-hour coverage stated in Items: the 20-minute Machine Time is planning metadata and cannot truncate or substitute for the long test. FurMark artifact/hash, exact burn-in preset, render/scanout settings, comparable score or stability threshold, ECC delta, thermal/power aborts and recovery are fail-closed Project Configuration Requirements. No PASS is allowed until those thresholds are approved, satisfying ED-15 without keeping the review decision pending.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1796, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, pending/conflict/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1797 / Wistron-HW-00430-V054 / 2a9b88c699beed10.
ED-14 says a short smoke cannot replace a formal long test. Items explicitly owns one hour, so the run must sustain 60 continuous minutes; the 20-minute Machine Time cannot be used as duration.
A separately authorized short calibration may validate capture/abort controls but returns no testcase PASS and does not count toward the one-hour soak.

ED-15 prevents PASS without an approved threshold. Exact performance/stability, ECC delta/severity, GPU core/memory/hotspot temperature, power/clock/throttle, driver/event and physical visual thresholds are mandatory runtime configuration.
The 1920x1080 requirement must be proven separately for FurMark internal render, Windows active mode and physical negotiated output; a screenshot alone is insufficient.
No download, installation, FurMark run, GPU stress, display action, SEL/log clear, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Sustain the approved FurMark/OpenGL workload for one continuous hour at verified 1920x1080 render and physical output, while validating display stability, GPU thermal/power/clock behavior and zero unacceptable ECC/platform-event deltas.
required_package: Approved FurMark 1.29.0.0 artifact/source/license/hash and exact burn-in preset, AA, fullscreen/window, render dimensions and command/GUI settings
Exact Windows/GPU/driver/VBIOS/OpenGL 4.6 identity and requested/active/negotiated 1920x1080 display path
Approved 60-minute continuous duration, sampling cadence, score/stability threshold and invalid-result rule
Approved GPU core/hotspot/memory temperature, power, clock/throttle, driver-reset/Xid/event and ECC baseline-delta-severity thresholds
Dedicated cooled maintenance window, bounded evidence storage, physical operator/capture and recovery/cooldown plan
test_case.test_command: REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; after all bindings and a separate execution OK, verify signed artifact hash, exact GPU/display identity, 1920x1080 render/active/negotiated modes, baseline ECC/events and safe thermal/power headroom without clearing logs. Launch only the approved FurMark 1.29.0.0 burn-in preset and run for 60 continuous minutes; any interruption invalidates the coverage and is not auto-retried. Sample GPU thermal/power/clock/throttle and platform events at the approved cadence, retain complete FurMark result/log and continuous or time-correlated physical display evidence, then collect final ECC/event deltas and health. Stop immediately at any approved abort limit.
test_case.expected_result: The approved FurMark preset runs continuously for at least 60 minutes at verified 1920x1080 render, Windows active mode and physical link; result/score meets the approved comparable threshold, no crash/hang/driver reset or disallowed throttle occurs, all thermal/power metrics remain within limits, ECC/event deltas remain within the approved zero/severity policy, and physical output shows no corruption, flicker, tearing, freeze or edge artifact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete uninterrupted one-hour evidence and every approved score/stability, resolution, visual, ECC/event and health threshold. A 20-minute run or short calibration cannot PASS. FAIL on interruption, wrong preset/resolution, missing threshold, invalid/incomparable result, artifact/hang, thermal/power/throttle/driver limit or unacceptable ECC/event delta. BLOCKED at runtime if artifact, license, parameters, thresholds, dedicated window, operator or recovery are absent. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Do not install from the named third-party URL until artifact source/license/hash is approved.
Do not run FurMark on production or without independent recovery, cooling/power headroom and explicit user confirmation.
Preserve existing SEL/Windows/GPU evidence; use complete baseline/delta collection rather than one ECC grep.
Stop at first thermal/power/clock/driver, ECC/event, display or evidence limit; do not auto-retry, reset or reboot.
Record cooldown/final health and treat an interrupted run as incomplete rather than accumulating segments.
expected_evidence: Approved artifact/hash/license, exact preset/settings, thresholds and 60-minute authorization
Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/OpenGL/display identity and separate render/active/negotiated 1920x1080 proof
Timestamped continuous runtime and complete FurMark result/validity/score
Thermal/power/clock/throttle timeline, complete ECC/SEL/Windows baseline-delta and final health
Time-correlated physical display evidence, abort/no-retry/cooldown/recovery audit and end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop FurMark on the first limit, preserve all evidence and do not retry. Use only the approved local Windows recovery path, allow the defined cooldown, verify driver/display/GPU/BMC health and restore the approved session; escalate if recovery fails. No automatic reset/reboot is authorized.
